text: But a new danger was building. Carbon dioxide, from three people breathing. Canisters of lithium hydroxide scrub it out of the air. Aquarius had round ones, and they were filling up. Odyssey had plenty of spares. But they were square, and they wouldn't fit the lunar module's round sockets. On the ground, engineers raced to build an adapter, using only things the crew had on board. Plastic bags. Cardboard from the flight plan. A spacesuit hose. A sock. And lots of duct tape. The crew built it from instructions read up over the radio. And the carbon dioxide level started to fall.
